gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 11 build entry now keeps the existing gpio_wdt lane, the bcm2835_wdt starter tests, and the bcm2835 survey checkpoint reviewable together so the watchdog tranche does not drift across simple-driver anchors.

A dedicated survey gate still matters after the starter lands and master advances because it keeps the remaining bcm2835_wdt gap explicit instead of letting the now-established scaffold imply platform or hardware parity that has not been implemented.

The survey note now records the current master head where the bcm2835_wdt starter and its probe-time bookkeeping helper are already landed while platform registration, PM base wiring, and poweroff-handler coordination remain out of scope.

The bounded starter now covers timeout tick encoding, running-bit detection, start and stop register transitions, restart intent, halt-partition bookkeeping, and a tiny probe summary for bootloader-carried running state, timeout and nowayout init, restart priority, and parent linkage without claiming platform-backed behavior.

Dedicated Phase 11 tests now keep timeout conversion, restart intent, halt-partition bookkeeping, and the bounded probe-time watchdog-core bookkeeping reviewable without pretending hardware-backed execution exists.

A dedicated slice note now documents exactly what the starter and probe-summary helper cover and what remains out of scope so the repo does not conflate the starter with full platform or poweroff integration.

The lane now lands a tiny probe-time summary around bootloader-carried running state, heartbeat and nowayout initialization, restart priority, stop-on-reboot setup, watchdog parent linkage, and system-power-controller eligibility before any platform registration or MMIO-backed behavior.

The next honest bcm2835_wdt step is a tiny registration-facing handoff and poweroff-handler summary so the starter can record already-running registration state and poweroff claim-vs-conflict outcomes without pretending PM base wiring or live watchdog registration exists.

Platform registration, PM base acquisition, the system power controller path, and live poweroff-handler coordination remain blocked until the lane has the landed probe summary plus a slightly richer registration-facing bookkeeping helper and a hardware-validation matrix that can describe those side effects honestly.
